Players Committee card image of [[Executor: Control Station (V)]] (the same image re-uploaded turned 90°; part of that version, not a separate one; no errata mark), printing: “'''Light Side:''' Force drain -1 here. If you initiate battle here, add one battle destiny.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/5794ee2/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/executorcontrolstation.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/executorcontrolstation.gif] as of commit 5794ee2 “image updates” (10 November 2020).
